clips.title: The story
paras: At Brill's edge, Deathguard Dillinger watches the town and guides newly arrived Forsaken. He also sends recruits against the Scourge remnants threatening the nearby farms and mills.

Deathguard Dillinger guards Brill and guides those arriving from Deathknell. At the town entrance, he points newly awakened undead toward the inn, town hall, and local trainers. They must learn their way through a changed life under the Dark Lady's rule.

Deathguard Dillinger sends capable recruits to clear mindless Scourge from nearby farms and mills. They cull rotting ghouls and reclaim infested facilities, building a safer border around Brill so the fledgling Forsaken settlements can endure the undead threat.
